slots.label: Paragraph 1
slots.default: No rigid packages and no surprises. We shape your support plan and price around your team, systems and goals, then give you a clear, no-obligation quote. Most businesses are surprised how affordable proactive, fully managed IT really is.

slots.label: Question 1
slots.default: What is a managed IT services provider (MSP)?

slots.label: Paragraph 2
slots.default: An MSP is an outsourced IT partner that proactively monitors, manages and secures your business technology. That covers IT support, cloud services, cyber security and disaster recovery, without the need for a full in-house IT team.

slots.label: Question 2
slots.default: Why use an MSP instead of an in-house IT team?

slots.label: Paragraph 3
slots.default: For a similar budget to a single hire, an MSP gives you a whole team with a broad skill set, proactive monitoring and expert cyber security, all for a fixed monthly cost that scales with your business.

slots.label: Question 3
slots.default: What types of businesses benefit from managed IT?

slots.label: Paragraph 4
slots.default: Any business that relies on technology. We support professional services, hospitality, healthcare, construction and more, keeping systems secure, compliant and productive.

slots.label: Question 4
slots.default: How much does managed IT support cost?

slots.label: Paragraph 5
slots.default: Pricing depends on the size of your business and the level of support you need. We offer flexible support plans with transparent, predictable monthly fees.
